verdict.rationale: The docs show Devin works against your repositories: you can index them to enable Ask Devin and DeepWiki, and private GitHub repos can be queried with authentication. So repo access exists in some form. Nothing in the pack describes how access is granted, and the onboarding material (environment configuration) suggests setup steps rather than a single click. Missing for 10: evidence of a one-click install (e.g., a GitHub app), a documented low-friction repo-connection flow, and hands-on corroboration that setup is simple.
